pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 g6 4.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured gxf6 (the g-pawn is on g6) and played Ne5 with no knight able to reach it; plan 2 broke a pin that doesn't exist (e7-pawn). Rewrote plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 g6 4.f3
pages.notes: Plan 2 put White's e4 push into Black's plan. Reworded plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 g6 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed a knight via c7 (pawn there) to g7 (bishop's square); plan 2 said Bg2 neutralises the dark-squared g7-bishop; plan 3 called Bg5 a pin; plan 1 led with ...g5-g4. Rewrote all four plans.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 1 swung the queen from e8 to h5 through the g6-pawn. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.Bg5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 called Bg5 a pin, promised doubled pawns and the bishop pair (White gives it up with Bxf6) and pressure on a d5-pawn that doesn't exist; plan 2 had ...gxf6. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Fianchetto Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Nf3-e1-d3 with no knight on f3 yet. Rewrote plan 3 (after Bg2, Nf3, O-O); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Leningrad Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...Qh4 through the e7-pawn; plan 2 missed White's main d4-d5 idea. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and through g6; plan 3 said controlling e4 prevents ...e5; plan 4 called b4-b5 a minority attack. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.Nc3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and through g6. Rewrote plan 2 (reviewer: first draft repeated ...d6, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Leningrad, 4.Nc3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and through g6; plan 2 called d6 a weakness. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.
